evidenceBinding: All expensive verification targets this implementation commit. A final documentation/evidence commit may follow only if the non-docs/README Git execution tree remains identical. No historic checkpoint test results are inherited.
correctedDefects: A blocked IndexedDB clear rejected even though its uncancellable deletion remained queued; the confirmed operation now stays pending with explicit close-tabs feedback.
WebKit could retain an identical file selection across document navigation and omit the change event; restore releases the picker selection after capturing each File.
A large backup export could exceed its own restore byte limit; export now rejects that size before download with module/media guidance.
Global restore file controls were available before React hydration and during a restore; they now wait for hydration and prevent overlapping selection.
Windows WebKit rejected native Blob storage; sanitized byte storage now preserves old Blob reads and versioned full-media archive portability.
Serial backup reads and integrity checks imposed avoidable browser waits; independent readonly reads and hashes now run concurrently.
New safety validators exceeded the unchanged bundle budget; tree shaking and route-family wrapper grouping restore headroom without removing features.
Blocked main/recovery upgrade requests could migrate after their promise rejected; cancelled upgrades now abort and recovery connections close on version changes.
Backups claimed to exclude active-workout pointers but included the IndexedDB pointer; new exports exclude it and legacy imports ignore it with guidance.
Fresh-profile global restore required visiting every owning module; one guided preparation action now calls owning migrations.
Preview could initialize the main database; all preview opens now abort upgrades and write no canonical records.
Malformed global envelopes could crash preview rendering; failed envelope results use a safe heading/summary.
Global restore omitted owning row and resulting-module validation, including relationships and cached immutable calculations.
Duplicate target stores, inconsistent schema versions, record counts and unsupported serializer/registry/module versions were not rejected.
A synchronous restore write error could leave queued writes alive; transactions now explicitly abort and close on failure.
Partial multi-database failure left recovery solely to the user; automatic before-image rollback is attempted and durable recovery retained on failure.
Keep-existing overwrote shell preferences; existing preferences now survive.
Global file reading/decompression and photo file sizes lacked byte bounds.
Imported media lacked signature/metadata/checksum/dimension and binary-manifest validation.
Full-media plus gzip produced an ambiguous portable profile; the UI separates the supported formats.
Search result/module labels exposed phase numbers; product names now replace those labels.
Comparison copy named the coding agent outside methodology; it now describes machine review.
Cross-browser push triggers omitted the finalization branch; the final branch now receives the hosted matrix.

accessibility.scope: Automated axe and browser checks; no claim of manual WCAG certification.

secretScan.limitations: Pattern-based current-tree/bundle scan; no claim of formal penetration testing or historical secret scanning.

securityReview.csp: Per-response nonce, same-origin script/connect, bounded optional youtube-nocookie frame. Narrow style-src-attr allowance remains documented. Browser nonce/hydration regressions pass.
securityReview.headers: Repository Vercel headers are configured. Actual deployed HTTPS/header/domain behavior remains owner verification.
securityReview.xss: React text rendering and validated URL/record inputs retained; the only inline HTML script is the static nonced theme initializer. No personal rich HTML rendering introduced.
securityReview.csv: Spreadsheet-safe escaping, formula-prefix handling and warned raw CSV preserved and tested.
securityReview.imports: Envelope/hash/row/media validation and whole-module candidate validation precede writes. Corruption/duplicates/future formats rejected; error preservation and rollback tested.
securityReview.workflows: SHA-pinned actions and contents:read permissions; no deployment job.

dataSafety.freshProfilePreparation: Owning migrations initialize all seven known databases by explicit browser action.
dataSafety.preview: Canonical data writes remain zero; existing target schemas are opened without upgrades.
dataSafety.restore: Keep-existing and confirmed replace pass exact-record comparison. Global import-as-copy remains explicitly unavailable without a safe cross-module ID remapper.
dataSafety.rollback: Durable before-images and automatic rollback pass injected partial-write failure regression; explicit recovery remains if rollback is blocked. Multi-database atomicity is not claimed.
dataSafety.photos: Canvas metadata removal, byte storage, legacy Blob compatibility, explicit full-media restore, ZIP export and portable-media exclusion pass.
dataSafety.limits: 100 MiB file/decompressed backup bound; photo 10 MiB and 20 MP limits. Export respects the supported restore size.
dataSafety.clear: Backup choice, typed confirmation and pending blocked-delete feedback retained.

healthSafety.diet: Adult eligibility, pregnancy/lactation unavailability, formula/assumption disclosures and conservative boundaries pass.
healthSafety.body: BMI remains screening/context; external composition/device estimates retain provenance. No fabricated body-fat or health score.
healthSafety.recovery: Soreness, pain and illness stay distinct; stop/urgent signals remain explicit, with no diagnosis or opaque recovery score.
healthSafety.sleep: Source/device labels retained; no diagnosis, fabricated stages or certain sleep-debt claims.
healthSafety.cardio: No fabricated VO2max, fitness age, universal Zone 2 or automatic calorie credit; estimates and stop signals remain labelled.
healthSafety.supplements: Label versions, unknown blend quantities and adverse-event handling retained; no prescriptions, efficacy guarantees or causal trial conclusions.

intentionalUnavailable.reason: No verified cross-module stable-ID remapper; UI explicitly disables this mode. Owning module copy modes remain available.
Optional profile deferred; UI explicitly states files are not encrypted or authenticated.
Browser limitation; durable before-image, automatic rollback and explicit recovery are implemented.
Separate ZIP is an export; explicit global full-media JSON provides tested restoration. Portable JSON excludes binaries.

ownerChecks: Meaningful use on real iOS/Android and desktop browsers, screen reader, keyboard and print.
Native OS file-save picker, real storage quota/eviction/persistence and external backup custody.
Vercel Preview, stable origin, actual HTTPS/security headers, DNS/TLS/canonical redirects and production smoke after owner deployment.
No independent human/clinical review of the factual subset is claimed.
deploymentStatement: Production deployment was NOT performed. Fitness OS is ready for the owner-controlled Vercel Preview and deployment stage.
